text:
sara: Quick sync — FortuneCustomer asked for an explicit decision on chat endpoint shape before enterprise kickoff. They want: messages-style first-class, backwards prompt compatibility, strict role semantics (system/user/assistant), structured output (JSON schema validation), and function/tool calling that can return typed results. Need to triage: must-have for their contract, nice-to-have for GA, and launch criteria.

amar: agree messages-first by default. we can accept raw prompt via a shim that converts to messages, but that adds complexity (prompt parsing edgecases).

li: perf note — messages payloads are slightly larger, affects 99th latency for short prompts. batching and prefix-cache handle most of it though. we should quantify with a small perf run.

maria: from UX, roles matter. customers expect system to be able to be multi-line and preserved; also want a way to pin an assistant persona. we should expose role hints in SDKs.

jordan: the customer specifically: "we have 300k existing hits/month to completions API (prompt-based). we can't migrate overnight. we need synchronous behavior and function outputs that map to our typed pipeline."

amar: proposal: 1) messages-first primary shape. 2) compatibility layer: accept a single string `prompt` and convert into messages [{role: "user", content: prompt}] on ingress with an explicit deprecation plan. 3) function-calling API stays the same semantics but we return a structured field `tool_result` when schema present.

sara: launch criteria (draft): - API accepts messages natively and prompt shim. - roles enforced: system mandatory? optional but validated if present. - function/tool calling: support for JSON-schema validated outputs + transform hooks. - migration docs + SDK support (python/js code samples). - telemetry: token breakdown by role and by function calls. - canary on Dedicated customers + opt-in for existing prompt users.

li: can we add a flag `role_strict=true|false` to control strict validation at the customer level? that helps enterprise that want stricter parsing.

maria: +1 to role_strict. also need example JSON-schema snippets in docs. quick sample: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}},
  "required": ["order_id"]
}
```

jordan: about rollout: customer asked for SLA and predictable latency. we should promise a migration window + performance targets (p99 < 500ms for typical short queries). Can we commit before Q2 planning?

amar: realistic: we can aim for Beta w/ compatibility shim and function-schema by end of Q2, GA after canary + perf tuning. need eng-resources: ~3 sprints dev + 2 sprints infra/testing.

sara: risks: - prompt shim won't cover handcrafted prompt templates with system role split. - SDK surface growth -> more maintenance. - structured outputs require schema validation libs and backwards compatibility on invalid outputs.

li: fallback policy idea: when schema validation fails, emit `structured_output_error` with raw assistant text and optional best-effort parse. that gives customers visibility.

maria: docs checklist: migration guide, examples of prompt->messages conversion, examples with function calling + schema, UI examples for Console to inspect role/token breakdown.

deploy-bot: Canary plan created: https://redwood.internal/boards/conv-shape-canary - initial cohort: 5 Dedicated customers + FortuneCustomer opt-in.

sara: action items: 1) Amar to write a short design doc (due EOD Fri) capturing shim and role_strict flag. 2) Li to run perf microbenchmarks for message vs prompt payloads (due next Wed). 3) Maria to draft docs/examples (first pass next Tue). 4) Jordan to coordinate FortuneCustomer expectations + opt-in timeline. I'll summarize for planning meeting. :thumbsup:

amar: on it.

li: will start perf run tomorrow.

maria: I'll mock up docs and Console flows.

jordan: will ping customer and scope opt-in amount.

sara: thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical record. we'll revisit after the design doc lands.
